entry.title: Jordan's ICONIC Eyes-Closed Free Throw Game | 35th Anniversary | November 23, 1991
entry.content:
35 years ago today, Michael Jordan gave us an unforgettable moment. Relive his 37-point performance against the Denver Nuggets on November 23, 1991—including his iconic eyes-closed free throw—as Chicago earned a 107-100 win.
